hooks.command: FILEPATH=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE 'packages/(backend|nestjs|core)/src/[^ "]*' | head -1); if [ -n "$FILEPATH" ] && ! echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -q 'adapters/'; then if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(from\s+["\x27]@prisma/client|import.*PrismaClient)'; then echo 'BLOCK: @prisma/client imports are not allowed in core package code (only in adapters/). Kit libraries use hexagonal architecture — define abstract storage interfaces in interfaces/ and implement Prisma adapters in adapters/.' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi
